title: Going deeper: A mistake is information
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Describe events, effort and impact without turning a moment into a permanent judgement.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The direction still needs to be followed.
practice: point to the missed step and try it again
principle: Turn a mistake into specific information for the next attempt.
nextSentence: The direction still needs to be followed. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can point to the missed step and try it again.
keyLearning: Turn a mistake into specific information for the next attempt.
